args.title: Bellwether Office: Retail returns logistics — combined summary
args.body:
- Newsletter (Bellwether Office): This week's topic is retail returns logistics, linking to a feature article plus a subscriber-only companion piece.
- Article (blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns): Apparel return rates reached 24%; consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
- Companion piece (insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion, subscriber access): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
